recipe.name: FunnelSwift served-SPA shells (static, no bundler)
evidence: hand-written preact/htm shells served straight from /opt/swift/nginx/www{,-app}/funnelswift - no bundler; an HTML-only FunnelSwift card needs no cargo at all

replaces the auto-detected Rust recipe (Cargo.toml): cargo build|test|run was wasted on 0-*.rs cards, and commit 38fbd9b's port 8080 pin made the readiness poll hit the LIVE container on 8080, so hermes verify reported PASS for changes it never exercised (kanban t_71523b62)
the recipe stays honest for Rust changes: the script runs the fmt/check/clippy compiler gate when a .rs file is dirty, and records 'no .rs file changed' otherwise

stage 4 refuses a BARE FRAGMENT: the Affiliate Guide answered 200 with correct bytes and sha parity while being unreadable in a browser (0 styleSheets, no <title>, windows-1252 mojibake), so the recipe asserts the served document shape, not just the status code
